fields.description: Uncheck to keep accepting and logging webhooks without sending any email. Logs show them as Received.
fields.label: Email Notifications Enabled

fields.description: Optional sender override. Leave empty to use the site's default outgoing email account.
fields.label: From Email

fields.description: Within this window, repeats of the same event for the same site are logged as Suppressed instead of emailed. 0 disables it, 1440 is the maximum.
fields.label: Dedupe Window (minutes)
About the dedupe window
fields.options: A flapping site cycling Active → Broken → Active sends one webhook per transition. Without this window a single bad night can burn a provider's daily send quota and silently stop every other notification.

fields.description: Master X-Webhook-Secret accepted by every endpoint. Generated at install. Rotate it only if you can update every sender that uses it.
fields.label: Global Fallback Secret
About secrets
fields.options: Each group also has its own secret, which is the one you should normally configure on a sender. The global secret exists as a master key and to keep unknown endpoints from being enumerated.
